messages:
Maya: heads-up — starting onboarding for manta-14b (FP16 baseline + int8 experiments). want a short rollout checklist for hosted/dedicated/private with canary percentages, QA gates, and obvious fallbacks.
Devon: +1. can we get perf/latency baselines first? p50/p95 for 512-token seq on current fp16 run. also mem/threads.
Samir: I ran a quick perf pass on dev infra yesterday: p50 32ms, p95 120ms, GPU mem 46GB for 512 tokens (fp16). int8 quant reduced mem by ~30% but p95 jumped to ~160ms on our test harness.
Lina: important to capture generation quality regressions — i'll add prompt set. we need eval buckets: safety, hallucination, instruction-following, long-context.
Maya: good. proposed canary plan: 1) internal canary (10% traffic synthetic), 2) limited external (1% real traffic), 3) ramp (10% -> 30% -> 100%) with rollback on quality or latency SLO. any objections?
Devon: no objections, but add staging smoke step: run 2000 samples from corpus with new tokenizer mapping and kv cache exercised. put a quality gate: if Rouge/ExactMatch drops >2% on core evals, block.
Samir: also add token-level divergence monitor and latency delta. i suggest thresholds: p95 latency increase >25% OR token divergence (edit distance normalized) >0.04 => fail.
Lina: QA checklist (short):
- run prompt_suite/v1 (5k prompts) and collect metrics
- run safety scans (toxic, PII heuristics)
- run hallucination regression (entity halluc tests)
- manual spot checks by 3 readers on top-20 failing prompts
Maya: ops checklist for deployment:
- build model bundle: model.tar.gz with weights + config + tokenizer.json
- produce quant profiles: int8, int4 (if applicable) with calibration logs
- add model_metadata.yml (version, knobs, expected mem)
- upload to artifact store and create canary release in console
Devon: config snippet for canary (example):
```yaml
canary:
  stages:
    - name: internal-sim
      traffic: 0.10
      checks: [smoke-tests, perf-profile]
    - name: limited-external
      traffic: 0.01
      checks: [eval-buckets, safety]
    - name: ramp
      traffic_steps: [0.10, 0.30, 1.0]
      checks: [latency, quality, error-rate]
fallbacks:
  primary: raven-13b-fp16
  secondary: manta-14b-fp16
```
Samir: ops-bot — please schedule a canary window for tomorrow 02:00-05:00 PST (low traffic).
ops-bot: scheduled canary run for model manta-14b at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z (window 3h). run-id: canary-179000-A. notifications to eng-ml and eng-oncall.
Lina: rollback/runbook notes:
- automatic rollback triggers: error-rate >0.5% over 5m, p95 > baseline*1.25, quality gate fail
- manual rollback: on-call confirms and triggers `redwood rollback --model manta-14b --to raven-13b-fp16`
- postmortem: capture prompt ids for failed cases and attach to eval ticket
Devon: dedicated/private nuances:
- dedicated: ensure reserved pool can handle peak concurrency; set autoscale headroom 20% lower than fp16 to account for quant perf delta
- private: provide local calibration tool and instructions for customer to run eval suite; include `--calibrate` artifacts and expected runtime memory numbers
Maya: quant experiments we want tracked per-build:
- quant scheme (sym/asym), per-layer quant error, calibration dataset, avg tokens/sec, p95 latency, mem footprint, quality deltas by eval bucket
Samir: small checklist for CI:
- unit test: tokenizer boundary cases
- integration: generate 100 samples, assert no OOM, assert latency < 500ms (dev infra)
- regression: run `eval-suite --suite prompt_suite/v1` and upload artifact
Lina: can someone own the initial manual read? i can do first pass on safety + hallucinations, need one more reviewer for instruction-following.
Maya: Samir can cover instruction-following. Devon will monitor perf dashboards and trigger rollback if needed. i'll coordinate release in console.
Devon: putting quick dashboard links: 
- perf dashboard: https://console/redwood/dashboards/manta-14b/perf
- regressions: https://console/redwood/evals/manta-14b/regressions
Samir: note — when testing int8 on our A100 fleet use `--cuda-cu102` image; some older nodes show perf variability.
Lina: final pre-canary checklist item: create ticket in evals board with sample IDs and expected thresholds. i'll file it now.
Maya: thanks all. plan for 02:00 PST canary tomorrow. I'll post a short status thread during the run. :rocket:
